assertions.assertion: The notification service implements SendLoginRequestAsync(BackchannelUserLoginRequest request, CancellationToken) and is registered via AddBackchannelAuthenticationUserNotificationService<T>()
Code uses request.BindingMessage and treats request.InternalId as sensitive (not exposed in the notification)
assertions.rationale: Uses request.BindingMessage and calls InternalId sensitive, not for text/logs.

assertions.assertion: The approval UI calls GetPendingLoginRequestsForCurrentUserAsync and GetLoginRequestByInternalIdAsync on IBackchannelAuthenticationInteractionService
Ownership is verified by comparing request.Subject.GetSubjectId() to the current user before completing

Approval calls CompleteLoginRequestAsync with a CompleteBackchannelLoginRequest whose ScopesValuesConsented is set (empty/null to deny), and the response notes the server rejects scopes not in the original CIBA request
assertions.rationale: CompleteLoginRequestAsync with ScopesValuesConsented; null to deny; notes server rejects extra scopes.
